title: Power mean transforms of operators
summary: In this paper, we introduce the power mean transform $P_λ(T)$ of an operator $T$ on a Hilbert space, which is a convex combination of some classical operator transforms such as the mean transform $M(T)$, the Aluthge transform $Δ(T)$, and the Duggal transform $T^D$. In particular, when $T$ is invertible, this transform coincides with the induced Aluthge transform $Δ_{\mathsf{m}_{f}}(T)$ recently defined by Yamazaki \cite{yamazaki-laa-2021} with $f(x)=(λ+(1-λ)\sqrt{x})^2$ for $x\in(0,\infty)$ and $λ\in(0,1)$.
